title: Evolutionary stability and payoff equivalence in an Eisert-Wilkens-Lewenstein quantum game
summary: An evolutionarily stable strategy (ESS) is a strategy that, once adopted by a population, cannot be invaded by any sufficiently rare alternative (mutant) strategy. We analyse evolutionary stability in an Eisert--Wilkens--Lewenstein (EWL) quantization of a symmetric $2\times2$ coordination game, whose classical mixed equilibrium $p^*=1/2$ is not an ESS. In the restricted two-parameter EWL strategy space, the corresponding quantum strategy is a strict symmetric Nash equilibrium and an ESS for every entanglement strength $γ>0$.
